summary.text: The Coleman-Mach 9330-33* zone thermostat runs up to four air conditioners or heat pumps and up to two heating sources from one wall unit on a 12 VDC control circuit. It reports problems as LCD text such as "Er" or a flashing "Gas", and a green LED on each zone control box shows control voltage and communication.

models.text: 9420*381 and 9420*382 digital wall thermostats: white LCD on black with a rotary push knob; the 9420-382 is the version supplied with plugs.
9630*352* heat pump thermostat, paired by Bluetooth to the RVClimate app; one thermostat holds up to 4 phones and one phone up to 3 thermostats.
9630*351* and 9630*353* heat pump thermostats share the same operation, lockout chart and RVClimate pairing as the 9630*352*.
6535-335* is a 2-stage heat pump wall thermostat for an RV Products 2-stage heat pump, connected by a 9-pin plug through a lifeline; the furnace connects to a 3-pin plug.
6536-335* is the 2-stage heat pump thermostat with backup heat: when the gas furnace comes on, the heat pump turns off.
The 9420-330 multi-zone touchscreen thermostat works with the 9430-754 Cool Only, 9430-758 Cool/Heat and 9630-758 Heat Pump NetZone control kits; operating voltage 9-16 VDC.
The 9420-391 needs 12 VDC power ("C" wire) and does not work with electric baseboard heat (120-240 V) or millivolt systems.
To identify a wall thermostat, remove it from the wall (wires can stay connected); the sticker on the back of the mounting plate carries the "RVP" number Coleman-Mach needs.

display.text: 9330: displays room temperatures from 41 F to 110 F while operating from -40 F to +175 F; colder readings show as 41 and hotter as 110.
9330 zone control box: the green LED lights with adequate 12 VDC, first flashes the number of times matching its zone jumper, then stops flashing once thermostat communication is established.
9420-381/382: during the 3-minute compressor/elec heat short-cycle delay, the HVAC state segment blinks if there is a call; "REMOTE" at the top means a remote sensor is in use.
9420-330: a zone reads "_ _" until its zone controller updates the temperature; a status LED on the back of the thermostat shows network diagnostics.

reset.text: 9420-381/382 manual reboot: press and hold the knob 12 seconds; at 4 s the units screen appears, then a countdown; when the display turns off, release the knob and it reboots.
9420-381/382: DIP switch changes take effect only after a reboot; cool, heat and cool+heat set points and temperature units are retained through power loss or reboot.
Heat pump thermostat lockout is a hard lockout: no reset bypasses it, and pulling the fuse will not reset it. One strike after lockout ends puts it back into lockout.

9420-391: "Reset settings" restores factory state and reconnects to the app automatically; "Reset Network Settings" clears Wi-Fi only and needs re-pairing. For a crash or no knob response, press the RST reset button to force a restart.

checks.text: 9330, no display: remove the ceiling assembly grille and look through the round opening of the control box for the green LED; if it is not lit, the control box has no power.
9330, Heat or Cool shows but settings will not change: that appliance may not be installed in this coach; check the homeowner packet for each zone's appliances.
9330: the setpoint cannot be adjusted with SYSTEM in OFF, the zone mode Off, or the fan set to run HIGH or LOW continuously.
9420-330: heat and cool cannot run at the same time in any zone; set all zones to Off before switching between Heat and Cool.
9420-330: in Elec Heat zones, gas heat assists automatically if electric heat takes more than 20 minutes or the room is more than 2 C / 4 F from set.

parts.text: 9420-381/382 have a self-resetting PTC fuse that opens on miswiring or a short; if it keeps opening, the fault must be located and corrected. Control circuit: 12 VDC, max 2 A.
9430 thermostats have a replaceable 2 amp fuse on the base that opens on miswiring or a short; before replacing it, the cause must be located and corrected. Control circuit max 1 amp.
9330: each zone has an upper unit control board in the return air plenum with zone and HP/NON-HP jumpers; zones other than zone 1 always need a remote room sensor.
9420-330: zone temperature sensor RVP 8330-310 on each zone control box is required on zones 2-4; zone 1 may use the internal thermistor module.

callTech.text: 9330: "Er" with a disrupted external room-sensor circuit, or two or more units operating identically (boards set to the same zone), call for a service technician.
9330: if the control box green LED is not lit, there is a problem with the 12 V DC control voltage and it must be serviced by a trained technician.
9330 DANGER: control board jumpers are set only with 115 VAC and 12 VDC disconnected; failure to do this could result in injury or death.
9420-391: do not change the minimum compressor off time unless you are a trained technical expert, and do not change advanced settings without consulting technical support.
